info.title: Vela Local API
info.summary: Vela Local API: an AdsPower-compatible loopback HTTP API served by a running Vela Browser.
info.description:
Vela Browser serves this API on the loopback interface only (http://127.0.0.1:50400). It has no authentication by design: any process on the same machine can call it. Local calls use the default AI access scope from Vela Browser settings, which initially grants access to all profiles. Never expose the listener beyond loopback with a reverse proxy, port forward, or tunnel. A CDP WebSocket URL returned by a browser start or active operation grants full control of that browser and its logged-in sessions; treat it like a credential.

Vela implements the routes listed here. It offers AdsPower V1 compatibility and V2 profile listing and browser control. The Vela extensions include browserCookies, the fp_verdict and fp_captured_at list fields, and the engine and chromium_runtime creation fields.

Responses use HTTP status 200 and the JSON envelope { code, msg, data }. Check code for success (0) or failure (-1). V2 routes and V1 group and user routes require the documented HTTP method. V1 browser-control routes accept other methods for compatibility.

The x-aliasmode-version-introduced field marks the earliest documented release for each operation.

servers.description: Vela Browser loopback listener. Loopback only; unauthenticated; never expose beyond the local machine.

tags.name: browser
tags.description: Start, stop, and inspect a profile's browser.

tags.name: group
tags.description: Profile groups. Vela Browser has no group ids, so the id equals the name.

tags.name: user
tags.description: Profile management in AdsPower's `user` vocabulary. A `user_id` is an Vela Browser profile id.

get.description: `/status` is the path AdsPower's own local API serves. Returns `code: 0` while Vela Browser is running. When lifecycle admission control is configured, `data.admission` reports its counters.

200.description: Always `code: 0`.

get.description: Same response as `/status`. May include `data.admission` statistics when admission control is configured.

200.description: Always `code: 0`.

get.description: Launches the browser process for the profile, or returns the running one. `data.ws.puppeteer` is the CDP WebSocket URL for automation clients. It grants full control of the browser; do not log or share it. Fails with `no such profile: <id>` for an unknown profile and with the launcher error otherwise.

parameters.name: launch_args
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON array of extra browser command-line arguments. Non-array or invalid JSON is ignored.

200.description: Success envelope with the CDP endpoint, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Captures session state and closes the browser. Returns `code: 0` with empty `data` once teardown is confirmed. Fails with `browser teardown unconfirmed: <id>` when the process could not be confirmed stopped.

200.description: Success envelope with empty `data`, or a failure envelope.

get.summary: Check whether a profile's browser is running
get.description: `status` is `Active` or `Inactive`. `lifecycle` reports a transition (`starting`, `stopping`) or `uncertain` when ownership-safe teardown is unconfirmed; `running` accompanies a certified live browser. `ws` is present only for `lifecycle: running`.

200.description: Success envelope with the browser state, or a failure envelope (missing `user_id`).

post.description: Creates a profile in the local store and returns its ID and display number. The engine generates a profile identity. Vela applies the supported fingerprint fields listed in this schema.

200.description: AdsPower-compatible response envelope.

post.description: Updates the saved local profile. Cookies are merged into the launch queue and applied at the next start. A running browser keeps its current identity until restarted.

200.description: AdsPower-compatible response envelope.

post.description: Lists permitted profiles by group, ID or displayed profile number. Results contain roster metadata and Unix second timestamps.

200.description: A page of profile records.

post.description: Starts or attaches to a profile through the shared lifecycle queue. Vela applies the saved session when opening a browser. Uses profile_id or profile_no and supports headless and approved launch_args. For a managed Chromium build, the first V2 start installs and verifies the corresponding ChromeDriver on demand. Use the returned webdriver path and ws.selenium debugger address to attach Selenium.

200.description: Browser connection details for Chromium or MCP engine capabilities.

get.description: Reports browser lifecycle status. Supply profile_id or profile_no. A certified Chromium browser includes its DevTools endpoint and debug port. A cached, verified ChromeDriver is returned when available.

schema.description: Stable Vela profile ID. Takes priority when both selectors are present.
Profile number shown in Vela. Use profile_id when numbers are ambiguous.

200.description: The current browser status.

post.description: Saves the session and closes the selected profile through the shared lifecycle queue.

200.description: Confirmed teardown.

post.description: Stop the selected profiles before deleting them. The response reports the deleted count and any profiles whose browsers could not be stopped.

200.description: AdsPower response envelope with deletion counts or a validation failure.

post.description: Trims the on-disk browser caches of the given profiles so user-data directories do not grow without bound. Compatibility clients fire-and-forget this after each session with `type: ["image_file"]`; `type` is accepted and ignored. Always returns `code: 0`; a missing or malformed body clears nothing.

200.description: Always `code: 0` with empty `data`.

get.summary: Read cookies from a running browser (Vela Browser extension)
get.description: Vela Browser extension to the AdsPower API. Reads cookies through Playwright's `context.cookies()` for the given URLs. The profile's browser must be safely running; otherwise the call fails with `profile not safely running: <id>` or `profile not running: <id>`. Cookie values are session credentials; handle the response accordingly.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of URLs whose cookies to return. Defaults to `https://x.com,https://twitter.com`.

200.description: Success envelope with the cookie list, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Returns one page of group names. `group_id` equals `group_name` because Vela Browser has no separate group ids. AdsPower's ungrouped id `"0"` maps to `""` and is never listed. Empty groups registered with `groupCreate` are included.

200.description: Always `code: 0`.

post.description: Registers a group so it lists before its first profile exists. Idempotent: the returned `group_id` equals the trimmed `group_name`. Fails with `invalid JSON body` or `missing group_name`.

200.description: Success envelope with the group id, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Returns one page of profiles in AdsPower's row shape. Filter with `group_id` (`"0"` or `""` selects ungrouped profiles). Sort with `user_sort`. Timestamps are Unix seconds; `0` means unknown or never opened. `fp_verdict` and `fp_captured_at` are Vela Browser additions: the fingerprint attestation verdict and capture time, or `""` when no attestation exists.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Only profiles in this group. `0` or an empty string selects ungrouped profiles.

parameters.name: user_sort
parameters.description: JSON object with one key, `created_time` or `last_open_time`, whose value is `asc` or `desc`. Malformed JSON keeps insertion order.

200.description: Always `code: 0`.

post.description: Creates an Vela Browser profile from an AdsPower-shaped payload. A blank `name` is replaced by the generated profile id. `group_id` `"0"` means ungrouped. `fingerprint_config.screen_resolution` uses AdsPower's `WIDTH_HEIGHT` form; omit it for a realistic random resolution. Unless `engine` or `chromium_runtime` names another browser, the new profile is a Chromium profile on every computer, because this API's clients use the CDP WebSocket from `browserStart`: Vela Chromium on Windows and the Chromium 155 beta on macOS and Linux. The dashboard, CLI, and MCP tools create Vela Firefox profiles on macOS and Linux instead. When a proxy is given, the browser timezone is matched to the proxy's location on a best-effort basis. Fails with `invalid JSON body` or the validation error.

200.description: Success envelope with the new profile id, or a failure envelope.

post.description: Stops each profile's browser, removes its browser data, and deletes the profile. Unknown ids are skipped. Profiles whose browser could not be stopped are left in place and returned in `locked`. Fails only with `invalid JSON body`.

200.description: Success envelope with counts, or a failure envelope.

post.summary: Rename a profile, update its saved credentials, or change its proxy
post.description: Each field is optional, but the request must change at least one. `name`, when sent, must be non-empty. Credential fields are applied only when present as strings. `user_proxy_config` replaces the proxy, or removes it with `proxy_soft: "no_proxy"`. A new proxy gets its exit IP's timezone unless the profile has a typed timezone; an open browser uses the new proxy from its next launch. Fails with `invalid JSON body`, `missing user_id`, `name must be a non-empty string`, `nothing to update: send name, account fields or user_proxy_config`, an invalid proxy message, `no such profile: <id>`, or `failed to persist profile update: <reason>`.

200.description: Success envelope with empty `data`, or a failure envelope.

UserId.name: user_id
UserId.description: Vela Browser profile id (AdsPower `user_id`). Missing values fail with `missing user_id`.

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based page number. Non-positive or non-numeric values fall back to 1.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Rows per page. Non-positive or non-numeric values fall back to 100.

Envelope.description: Every Local API response. HTTP status is always 200; `code` carries the outcome.

msg.description: `success` on success, otherwise the failure reason.

Failure.description: Failure envelope. `msg` explains the reason; `data` is always empty. Unknown routes return `unknown route: <path>`.

AdmissionStats.description: Lifecycle admission counters, present only when admission control is configured.

puppeteer.description: CDP WebSocket URL (`ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/devtools/browser/<id>`). Grants full control of the browser; treat it as a secret.

selenium.description: Always empty. Vela Browser exposes CDP only.

debug_port.description: Remote debugging port as a decimal string.

webdriver.description: Always empty. Vela Browser ships no WebDriver binary.

warning.description: Optional non-fatal advisory message produced during profile launch.

lifecycle.description: Present with `Active`. `running` means a certified live browser; the other values describe a transition or unconfirmed teardown.

profile_id.description: One profile id or a list of ids.

type.description: AdsPower cache categories such as `image_file`. Accepted for compatibility and ignored; Vela Browser clears its disk caches.

expires.description: Unix seconds. `-1` or absent for session cookies.

group_name.description: Group name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

fp_verdict.description: Vela Browser addition: fingerprint attestation verdict, or `""` when no attestation exists.

fp_captured_at.description: Vela Browser addition: attestation capture time as an ISO 8601 string, or `""`.

ProxyConfig.description: AdsPower `user_proxy_config`. Ignored unless `proxy_host` is a non-empty string.

proxy_port.description: Port as a string. Numbers are accepted and converted.

UserCreateRequest.description: AdsPower-shaped profile payload. All fields are optional; unknown fields are ignored. Prefer the snake_case credential names; `emailPassword` and `twofa` are accepted aliases.

name.description: Profile name. Blank names become the generated id.

group_id.description: Group name. `0` or empty means ungrouped.

domain_name.description: Platform the account belongs to, for example `x.com`.

engine.description: Vela Browser field. Browser engine of the new profile. Defaults to `chromium` on every computer, because this API's clients use the CDP WebSocket from `browserStart`, which only Chromium profiles have. `firefox` creates an Vela Firefox profile, which has no CDP WebSocket.

chromium_runtime.description: Vela Browser field for Chromium profiles; it implies `engine` `chromium`. `aliasmode` is Vela Chromium 155, the default where this computer can run it. `cloakbrowser` creates a CloakBrowser (Chrome 146) profile. CloakBrowser profiles on one computer can be linked to each other.

id.description: New profile id. Use it as `user_id` elsewhere.

user_ids.description: Profile ids to delete. A non-array value deletes nothing.

locked.description: Profile ids kept because their browser could not be stopped.

name.description: New profile name. Optional; non-empty when sent.

user_proxy_config.description: New proxy. `proxy_host` and `proxy_port` are required unless `proxy_soft` is `no_proxy`, which removes the proxy.

profile_id.description: Stable Vela profile ID. Takes priority when both selectors are present.

profile_no.description: Profile number shown in Vela. Use profile_id when numbers are ambiguous.

profile_id.description: Stable Vela profile ID. Takes priority when both selectors are present.

profile_no.description: Profile number shown in Vela. Use profile_id when numbers are ambiguous.

headless.description: Use 1 for headless or 0 for a visible window. Omission uses the manager default.

launch_args.description: HTTP(S) startup URLs and the same approved flags as the V1 route.

lifecycle.description: Present with `Active`. `running` means a certified live browser; the other values describe a transition or unconfirmed teardown.

debug_port.description: Loopback debug port of a certified Chromium browser.

webdriver.description: Absolute path to the verified ChromeDriver on the Vela host. Empty when a matching driver is unavailable.

capabilities.description: Native MCP automation capabilities reported by the engine.

group_id.description: Group name. Use 0 for ungrouped profiles or omit to list all permitted groups.

puppeteer.description: CDP WebSocket URL (`ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/devtools/browser/<id>`). Grants full control of the browser; treat it as a secret.

selenium.description: Loopback Chrome DevTools debugger address for Selenium, in 127.0.0.1:port format.

debug_port.description: Remote debugging port as a decimal string.

webdriver.description: Absolute path to the verified ChromeDriver on the Vela host. Empty when a matching driver is unavailable.

warning.description: Optional non-fatal advisory message produced during profile launch.

capabilities.description: Native MCP automation capabilities reported by the engine.

warning.description: Optional non-fatal advisory message produced during profile launch.

group_id.description: Vela group name, or 0 for ungrouped.

platform.description: Platform domain used as a default startup page.

tabs.description: Saved startup pages. An empty list clears this setting.

oneOf.description: Cookie JSON or Netscape cookie text

ignore_cookie_error.description: Use 1 to ignore malformed rows of a Netscape cookie file.

user_proxy_config.description: HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 endpoint, or proxy_soft no_proxy for a direct connection. Pass this field or proxyid.

proxyid.description: Local proxy pool node ID or random to choose an enabled node. Pass this field or user_proxy_config.

language.description: Vela uses the first language to generate the profile locale.

language_switch.description: Use 1 for an automatically selected locale.

automatic_timezone.description: Use 1 for proxy-based timezone and 0 for manual.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Empty selects the local setting in manual mode.

fingerprint_config.description: These fields configure Vela's native fingerprint generator.

repeat_config.description: Allow duplicates (0), or check account (2), Cookie jar (3) and Facebook c_user (4).

engine.description: Vela browser engine. Defaults to Chromium.
